note: Popov-Chang syndrome is primarily characterized by neurodevelopmental and behavioral phenotypes, though one recent study links YWHAZ variation to developmental delay with brain malformation.

evidence.text: A 2023 study reports YWHAZ variation associated with intellectual disability and global developmental delay alongside brain malformation, which may qualify the claim regarding brain malformations.

source.title: YWHAZ variation causes intellectual disability and global developmental delay with brain malformation
